theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_mcr_homogeneous_infinite_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (x₀ : Euclid P), 1 ≤ n → (∀ x, g x = (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal) → μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x, g (t • x) = g x) → 0 < g x₀ → μ univ = ∞
